rows.question: Can a user or model invoke each skill in a session, and with what text?
rows.method: OpenCode.app 2.2.5 paired with `opencode pair` (local link, no --remote) to the disposable profile's managed service on 127.0.0.1:47618 (CLI 2.1.4); provider via an exported environment API key; throwaway workspace .t010/ws-throwaway; session prompts in .t010/HANDOFF-opencode.md; sessions exported with `opencode session export` to .t010/obs-ses_*.json (untracked).
commands: Prompt: list the skills named analyze, plan, evidence, execute, recover or setup without calling a tool
Prompt: use the analyze skill on workspace 6cb1f07e39191fa91feafa9ff4a81a02 for two edits of README.md (no format given)
Prompt (retry): call agent-braid_analyze-work with kind aim and request = examples/analysis/file-edits-conflict.json
observation: The model listed all six skills (analyze, plan, evidence, execute, recover, setup) as loadable.

Asked to use the analyze skill, the model loaded it (skill tool, id 'analyze', path .../node_modules/agent-braid/skills/analyze) and followed it to agent-braid_analyze-work with the explicit workspace id.

First call: the model invented request {units:[{id, writes:[README.md]}]}; result status 'refused', summary 'analyze-work refused: The bounded operation was refused', no reason given (findings F1, F2 below).

Retry with a valid AIM analysis input: status 'ok', 'analyze-work completed with a valid core result', classifications conflicting 1 / independent-candidate 0 / ordered 0 / unknown 0, pair edit-readme vs edit-readme-intro 'conflicting', constraint 'serialize-or-isolate', limits state no execution authority; one evidenceRef was stored.
F1: the analyze-work input schema only says request is 'object or array' and the analyze skill gives no AIM shape, so a model cannot build a valid request unaided (host-independent; also in alpha.6).
F2: analysis.InvalidAnalysis is not a ToolingError, so agent_braid/tooling_mcp.py _safe_error replaces its message with the generic refusal text (host-independent).
limits: Model answers are the model's report of what it sees; the tool calls and results were confirmed from the session exports.
Skill text was not compared byte-for-byte in session; package digest identifies it (row 06).

summary.contradiction: Row 14: the host loads skills from directories above the project's Git root and an ancestor skill replaced a plugin skill, while plugin doctor --host opencode reports nothing for it; the contract limits discovery to the directory-to-Git-root range. Resolved for 0.1.0-alpha.7 by commit 96f30b7c (PR #1030); the observed candidate predates the fix.
findings: F1 analyze-work input schema does not describe the AIM request shape
F2 InvalidAnalysis reasons are masked as a generic refusal
F3 setup step 11 names telemetry-audit, which the OpenCode entry does not register

limits: Single host version and platform (macOS arm64); local Git source only.

Nothing here is a grant, approval, release or owner acceptance. Rows 22-23 stay unobserved and are declared limits of the published 0.1.0-alpha.7: row 22 needs Linux, row 23 needs request inspection. Row 21 was observed on 2026-11-04 as a post-publication smoke (release record: release-acceptance-alpha7.md).
